title: 第1章 教堂第2章 衔尾蛇石碑
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 昏暗天空，阴云如盖。
荒芜大地上迷雾蒙蒙，望不到尽头。
一面庞大、古迹斑驳的黑色石碑矗立。
闹铃在耳边震动，声音短促，躺在床上的林野意识渐渐清醒。
撑起上身，揉了揉有些发涨的脑袋。
‘刚刚那是，梦？’
坐到床边，随手按下显示着20:00的闹铃开关，打量着眼前的陌生房间。
房间不大，格子状天花板，床边过道只能同时站开两个人。
右手边，床头旁的窗户下摆着一张书桌，老旧发黄的大头电脑黑着屏。
床尾那头房门紧闭，门上还是那种老式铜制圆形把手，磨得发亮。
‘我不是在挑战尾崎八项的终极信任吗？’
清醒几分，他回忆起沉入水底的那一刻。
碧蓝的天空整个进入眼中，那是一种从未有过的空旷和放松，仿佛一切都在离他远去。
这个念头刚刚闪过，就像是触发了什么开关，钝痛感从后脑传来，模糊的记忆片段涌入脑海。
过了一会，他轻轻按揉太阳穴。
“原来，是撞大运了。”
抬起头，他望向窗外。
‘黎亚联邦，星球面积大了三倍以上。’
‘科技水平已经相当于21世纪了，只是联邦内各个行省大有割据一方的意思。’
“哗啦”一声拉开书桌抽屉，拿出一个学生证。
海岸大学药学系——林野。
右上角的一寸照片是个清秀大男孩。
“二十岁的身体，真是充满了活力。”
“就是瘦了点。”
把学生证放回去，起身坐到书桌前，大头电脑旁是一个日历表。
联邦历2028年6月30号，周五。
大三暑假前的最后一天。
手指无意识敲打着桌面，他的思绪有些乱，月光从窗户投进来，覆下一层光斑。
正想着，他忽地抬头，注意力放到门外，隐隐传来一个年轻女声。
“妈，这次铁琴集团内培生的机会多少人都在盯着，就等我掉下来！”
“我也不想拿小野这六万学费，可错过这次还怎么翻身？”
content_en:
The sky is dark and cloudy.
The desolate land is covered in mist, with no end in sight.
A huge black stone monument with mottled ancient ruins stands there.
——"Didi! Didi!"——
The alarm vibrated in his ears with a short sound, and Lin Ye's consciousness gradually woke up while lying on the bed.
He raised his upper body and rubbed his swollen head.
‘That was just a dream? ’
Sitting on the edge of the bed, he casually pressed the alarm switch that showed 20:00, and looked at the unfamiliar room in front of him.
The room was small, with a coffered ceiling, and the aisle beside the bed could only accommodate two people at the same time.
On the right side, there is a desk under the window next to the bedside, and an old, yellowed computer with a black screen.
The door at the end of the bed was closed, and the door still had the old-fashioned brass round handle, polished to a shine.
‘Am I not challenging Ozaki’s ultimate trust? ’
When he regained consciousness, he recalled the moment he sank to the bottom of the water.
The blue sky came into his eyes, and he felt a sense of emptiness and relaxation that he had never experienced before, as if everything was leaving him.
Just as this thought flashed across his mind, it was like a switch was triggered. A dull pain came from the back of his head, and vague memory fragments flooded into his mind.
After a while, he gently rubbed his temples.
"It turns out it was a stroke of luck."
Raising his head, he looked out the window.
‘Lea Federation, the planet’s area is more than three times larger. ’
‘The technological level is already equivalent to that of the 21st century, but each province in the federation is trying to separate itself. ’
With a "clatter", he opened the desk drawer and took out a student ID card.
Department of Pharmacy, Coast University - Linye.
The one-inch photo in the upper right corner is of a handsome boy.
"A twenty-year-old body is really full of energy."
"I just lost a little weight."
Putting his student ID card back, he stood up and sat down at the desk. Next to the large computer was a calendar.
Friday, June 30, 2028 in the federal calendar.
The last day before the summer vacation of junior year.
His fingers were tapping on the table unconsciously, and his thoughts were a little confused. The moonlight came in from the window, covering it with a layer of light spots.
Just as he was thinking about it, he suddenly raised his head and turned his attention to the door, where a young female voice could be heard faintly.
"Mom, many people in Tieqin Group are watching this opportunity for Pearson, just waiting for me to fall!"
"I don't want to take Xiaoye's 60,000 tuition fee, but how can I stand up if I miss this time?"
